title: Financial Institution Financing Sales - VP
description: Financial Institution Financing Sales - VP Financial Markets is part of the ING Wholesale Bank, which represents all Corporate and Investment Banking activities of ING. We have a global footprint with local reach, deep sector expertise and we play a pivotal role in areas of sustainability and innovation. FM is the bank’s gateway to the professional markets around the world. In short, we assist our clients with investment and hedging risks by means of derivatives and we distribute bonds, loans, and equities towards investors. The client related business is supported by Trading, Structuring and Research expertise. Our main goal is to help our clients navigate the markets to position them for consistent and stable growth. Department Overview: Institutional Sales within Financial Markets provide both flow and bespoke financial solutions to clients. We are functionally structured to reflect the differing needs of our clients. This is enhanced with the specialist non-flow service from the Client Solutions Group. We transact and offer client solutions in a broad range of products including (among others) foreign exchange, interest rate derivatives, money markets, financing, primary and secondary fixed income and structured products. This structure enhances cross-selling, improves the flow of market/product information and aims to deepen client relationships through a platform capable of delivering a variety of products to a diverse client base. Our local footprint of circa 300 salespeople across 28 locations, ensures that sales teams are in close proximity to our clients, delivering global expertise with local insight. Main Duties and Responsibilities of Role: A public side financial market sales role focused on delivering Financing (Repo, Money Markets, broader financing such as securitised/structured products) to financial institutions in the UK, MENA and Switzerland. Sales coverage of existing clients, expansion of the Financing client base, and business growth in cooperation with colleagues across the European locations and globally. Active support to other London Salespeople Close collaboration with the eSales colleagues ranging from strategy to the transactional level FI clients include both hedgers and investors, such as regional and private banks, financial sponsors, insurance companies, traditional and alternative strategy asset managers, Real Money, Hedge Funds etc Strong Financing knowledge is critical for this position with a sophisticated customer base using both voice and electronic dealing streams. The candidate will need to play an active role in marketing and execution of this business Expert understanding of price creation and validation for all vanilla and exotic Financing products Responsibility for day-to-day new client onboarding for the FI team, working closely with the relationship managers and the Front Office Support teams to get all requirements in place in a timely and efficient manner Ongoing monitoring to ensure all upcoming CDD/KYC/EMIR/MIFID/DF expiries and requirements are managed to prevent any down time in client dealing ability Work closely with colleagues in Trading to ensure we optimise our capabilities and risk appetite Experience or familiarity with trade execution through relevant voice and e-Systems. Outstanding ability to focus on core issues and attention to detail with swift execution in a fast-paced environment Proactive role in the constructive feedback loop, aiming to continuously improve ING’s tools, methods and way-of-working Partner with Client Solutions Group and Research in distributing their content, publications and trade ideas How to succeed We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself. SAML brings together specialist lawyers working closely with the Global Markets business area for clients in the UK and overseas. The team supports business across a variety of debt capital markets transactions for its clients. Products include securitisations, unsecured primary bond issuance (IG/HY), private placements, social housing bonds and liability management exercises as well as other innovative capital markets products in the ESG, digital and PVLB spaces. We’re looking for a lawyer to support primarily on securitisation transactions involving various asset classes. These include mortgage loans, credit cards, auto loans and trade receivables. The role covers the structuring and development of transactions through to launch. You’ll also have the chance to learn about other types of debt capital markets transactions supported by the team, and to collaborate on initiatives with colleagues across Legal & Secretariat (L&S). Now is a superb time to join us, given this is a growing and strategic area for the Group and a market-leading business area. You would become part of a positive, encouraging and pragmatic legal team, reporting directly to the Head of Legal of SAML. As Lloyds Banking Group delivers its new Accelerate 2030 strategy, L&S has an important role to play in helping the business grow safely and sustainably, maintaining a strong people-centred culture and delivering better client outcomes through simplification, technology and innovation. If you’re searching for a great opportunity to continue building your knowledge and to develop your career, you can achieve these goals in this role. What you’ll be doing: Providing high-quality, pragmatic legal advice on a broad range of securitisation transactions, supporting the business from initial structuring discussions through to execution and post-closing activities. Advising on transactions across a range of asset classes, including residential mortgages, credit cards, auto loans and trade receivables, helping the business identify and manage legal and regulatory risks. Negotiating complex transaction documentation, working closely with internal stakeholders, external counsel, issuers and other market participants. Supporting the development and delivery of innovative funding and capital markets solutions, ensuring legal advice is aligned to commercial objectives and client outcomes. Building trusted relationships with colleagues across Global Markets, Risk, Compliance and Legal & Secretariat, acting as a valued adviser on strategic and day-to-day matters. Monitoring legal and regulatory developments affecting securitisation and debt capital markets products, providing clear guidance on potential impacts to the business. Contributing to wider Legal & Secretariat initiatives that enhance legal risk management, operational efficiency, knowledge sharing and colleague development. Why join us? description: Du hörst nie auf, neugierig zu sein, und willst jeden Tag dazulernen. Und das am liebsten von den Besten und mit den besten Aussichten. Du suchst die Herausforderung und möchtest endlich die Theorie Deines Studiums in die Praxis umsetzen. Genau das brauchst Du, um bei einem Praktikum bei uns richtig durchzustarten. Deine Aufgaben Du bist von Tag eins an direkt dabei und unterstützt unsere Profis bei der Betreuung deutscher und österreichischer Unternehmenskunden sowie institutioneller Kunden wie Banken, Fondsgesellschaften, Pensionskassen und Versicherungen. Du unterstützt aktiv die Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Kapitalmarkttransaktionen (Anleiheemissionen). Risikomanagement und die Abwicklung von Handelsgeschäften sind dabei Deine größten Themen bei uns und Du analysierst mit neusten Analysetools das Geschäftstreiben. Du tauchst tief darin ein und kannst so Kundenbesuche sowie aktuelle Kapitalmarktthemen vor- und aufbereiten. Wenn Du Dich jetzt noch 1) für unser Produktspektrum aus Zins-, FX-, Rohstoff- und Aktien-Derivaten, Schuldscheinen sowie Anleihen in Primär- und Sekundärmarkt interessierst, 2) analysieren und präsentieren kannst und 3) gerne mit ING-Einheiten auf der ganzen Welt zusammenarbeiten möchtest, bist Du bei uns genau richtig. Wir freuen uns auf Deinen Input! Dein Profil Immatrikuliert im Bachelor / Master in Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder im Gap Year zwischen Bachelor- und Master-Studium Nachweis über Kursbelegung in Finance mit Derivate Pricing-Bezug an der Hochschule Erste praktische Erfahrung mit Kapitalmarktprodukten und Bloomberg notwendig Sehr gute Kenntnisse in PowerPoint und Excel, insbesondere in der Erstellung professioneller Präsentation sowie der Analyse und Aufbereitung von Datensätzen Leidenschaft für die Entwicklungen an den Finanzmärkten Organisationstalent, hohe Leistungsbereitschaft & Eigeninitiative, Zuverlässigkeit & Sorgfalt Kommunikativer Teamplayer mit hoher Kundenorientierung Willen, die Welt von morgen mitzugestalten Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch sind ein Muss Verfügbar für 6 Monate ab Oktober 2026 (bitte gib den genauen Zeitraum inkl. Startdatum im Anschreiben an) Freu Dich auf zahlreiche Benefits Ansprechende Vergütung, kostenloses Deutschlandticket, 30 Tage Urlaub, Betriebsrestaurant Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe in einer Du-Kultur Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Zusätzlich zur Arbeit im Büro kannst Du auch mobil arbeiten – im Rahmen betrieblicher, gesetzlicher und regulatorischer Anforderungen. Löwenstarke Netzwerkangebote, persönliche und fachliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie vielfältige Angebote zu Bewegung, Vorsorge, Ernährung und Balance Lust auf einen neuen Job? Bei der ING sind wir bunt und vielfältig: unterschiedliche Persönlichkeiten mit verschiedenen Perspektiven - in einer internationalen Kultur, in der wir uns wertschätzen. Dabei tragen wir Sneaker und Pumps, Hoodies und Anzüge. Weil Menschen nicht in Schubladen passen. Na, wie wärs? Senior Enhanced Index Portfolio Manager This is a great job for someone who has deep knowledge of passive equity investing with sophisticated quantitative and engineering capabilities. A bit about the job: We are seeking a highly experienced Enhanced Index Portfolio Manager to join our Portfolio Implementation & Investment Engineering team. With deep expertise in managing passively constructed equity beta solutions, the successful candidate will play a leading role in shaping the evolution of our Enhanced Index strategies, driving process innovation, and ensuring strong alignment between portfolio outcomes and investment intent. The Enhanced Equity business has experienced significant growth in AUM over the last 3 years to £65bn under management and expected to double over the next few years. The new addition to the team will combine deep knowledge of passive equity investing with quantitative and engineering capabilities, contributing to the design, optimisation, and day-to-day implementation of our strategies. As a senior practitioner, you will provide both thought leadership and hands-on portfolio management execution within a collaborative team environment. In this role, you will lead enhancements to our investment processes—refining models, strengthening portfolio construction, overseeing liquidity and cash equitisation, rebalancing, corporate actions, guideline compliance, and ongoing risk and performance monitoring. You will also drive index methodology and event analysis, translating changes such as additions, deletions, IPOs, free‑float adjustments, and sector reclassifications into proactive portfolio positioning and efficient implementation across mandates. Working closely with Investment Engineering and Trading, you will help design and industrialise scalable tools that improve risk management, liquidity assessment, portfolio construction, execution quality, and operational efficiency. title: Acquisition Finance Portfolio Management - Associate
description: Acquisition Finance Portfolio Management Associate About the Role We have an exciting opportunity to join ING's Acquisition Finance Portfolio Management (AF PM) team in London. As an Associate within our front-office lending team, you will help manage a portfolio of leveraged finance transactions, supporting portfolio performance, credit monitoring, and capital optimisation initiatives. You will work closely with colleagues across Acquisition Finance Origination, Capital Markets & Advisory, Transaction Approval & Control, Legal, and other lending teams, while building strong relationships across the wider business. Key Responsibilities Portfolio Management & Credit Monitoring Support Portfolio Managers in the day-to-day management of Acquisition Finance clients and transactions. Conduct ongoing credit analysis, covenant monitoring, and financial performance reviews. Assist with refinancings, amendments, waivers, and other credit modifications. Identify and escalate potential credit concerns and early warning indicators. Support restructuring and workout situations when required. Portfolio Reporting & Analytics Prepare portfolio reports, risk reviews, and management information. Contribute to quarterly Credit Risk Management, Watchlist, and Loan Loss Provision reviews. Maintain portfolio databases, trackers, and performance metrics. Support lending limit management and capital velocity initiatives, including loan sales and risk transfer programmes. Client & Stakeholder Engagement Work closely with Relationship Managers and sector specialists to support client discussions and identify business opportunities. Contribute to cross-sell initiatives and portfolio-driven growth opportunities. Collaborate with offshore support teams and internal stakeholders across functions and regions. Continuous Improvement Support process improvement and transformation initiatives. Help enhance credit monitoring and operational efficiency. Contribute to the development of junior colleagues and new joiners. What We're Looking For Experience & Qualifications University degree (CFA and/or MBA advantageous). 3+ years' experience in lending, leveraged finance, credit analysis, or portfolio management. Strong financial analysis and cashflow modelling skills. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; Power BI is beneficial. Exposure to Acquisition Finance, Project Finance, Infrastructure, Energy, Transport, Technology, or other specialised lending sectors is desirable. French and/or Spanish language skills are beneficial but not essential. Skills & Competencies Strong credit and analytical capabilities. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Collaborative team player with the ability to work across functions and regions. Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities. Knowledge of lending documentation and credit processes. Proactive, self-motivated, and committed to continuous improvement. Why Join ING? At ING, you'll have the opportunity to work in a dynamic international environment while developing your career within a leading global bank. We offer: Private medical, dental and health cover Competitive pension and financial wellbeing benefits Hybrid working and flexibility to work abroad for up to 30 days Generous annual leave and family-friendly policies Learning, mentoring and international career development opportunities Employee wellbeing programmes, social clubs and volunteering initiatives Learn more about careers at ING: ING Careers

title: Director Trade Solution Sales – Wholesale Banking (w/m/d)
description: ING Wholesale Banking Germany steht für das Firmenkundengeschäft der ING Deutschland. Über die klassische Unternehmensfinanzierung hinaus, beraten wir unsere Firmenkunden bei nachhaltigen und innovativen Finanzierungsprojekten – mit Start-up-Esprit und dem Anspruch, immer einen Schritt voraus zu sein. Bewirb Dich jetzt bei ING Wholesale Banking, einer der am schnellsten wachsenden Unternehmenskundenbanken in Deutschland! Deine Aufgaben Du bist der Dreh- und Angelpunkt für unsere Dokumenten-, Trade-, Finance- und Working-Capital-Lösungen: Souverän übernimmst Du die Vertriebsverantwortung und beantwortest als Hauptansprechperson alle offenen Fragen. Dein Ziel: Die ING als strategischen Partner für Trade Finance und Working Capital zu positionieren und als Sparringspartner für z. B. CFOs oder Finanzorganisationen zu Themen rund um Wachstum, Effizienz und Resilienz entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zu etablieren. Mit Blick auf Zukunft, Nachhaltigkeit und Wachstum verantwortest Du die Weiterentwicklung des Transaction-Services-Geschäfts, treibst Cross- und Deep-Selling-Ansätze voran und baust so unseren Wallet Share und Marktanteil stetig aus. Dabei verstehst Du, was Kunden wollen und brauchen, identifizierst und löst Kundenherausforderungen in Supply Chain, Working Capital, Liquidität oder Treasury und orchestrierst für Deine Kunden Transaction-Services-Produkte maßgeschneidert und end-to-end. Auch in der Neukundengewinnung hast Du das Heft in der Hand, vertreibst lokale und internationale Trade-Finance-Lösungen und entwickelst Prospects sowie neue Zugangspunkte, mit denen Du effektiv Kunden für unsere Trade-Produkte und -Dienstleistungen gewinnst. Natürlich arbeitest Du hierbei in jedem Schritt eng mit den relevanten Fachbereichen und Kolleg*innen zusammen, findest gemeinsam optimale Lösungen und sorgst dafür, dass Transaction-Services-Prioritäten in unseren Kundenstrategien verankert werden. Mit Daten und Fakten zu Märkten, Kunden und Vertrieb erkennst Du Chancen und Potenziale, leitest wirkungsvolle kommerzielle Maßnahmen ab, mit denen wir unser Produkt- und Dienstleistungsportfolio weiterentwickeln, und bringst diese in unsere Abläufe ein. Bei alldem bist Du Vorreiter für Innovation, lebst den effektiven Einsatz von digitalen Tools, Datenanalysen und KI-Anwendungen und hebst so Vertriebswirksamkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Qualität auf das nächste Level. Und natürlich teilst Du Deine Expertise zu Produkten und Prozessen gerne, greifst internationalen Kolleg*innen z. B. bei Ausschreibungen unter die Arme und repräsentierst die ING Deutschland auf Events, Konferenzen und Messen souverän und überzeugend. Dein Profil Studium in BWL, VWL o. Ä. oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Langjährige Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb von Trade-Finance-, Working-Capital- oder vergleichbaren Treasury-Lösungen Fundierte Fach- und Marktkenntnisse im Bereich Trade Solutions sowie die Fähigkeit, moderne, softwaregestützte, digitale Lösungsansätze in der Kundenberatung einzusetzen Belastbares Netzwerk in relevanten Large-Corporate-, Treasury- und Finance-Zielgruppen sowie nachweisbare Erfolge in der Neukundengewinnung und der Entwicklung und Ausschöpfung von Kundenpotenzialen Sicher im Umgang mit datenbasierten Vertriebsansätzen, digitalen Arbeitsmitteln sowie KI-Anwendungen mit dem Bestreben, sie in die tägliche Arbeit zu integrieren Tiefes Verständnis für Treasury-Prozesse, Liquiditätssteuerung und Working-Capital-Optimierung sowie idealerweise für Kreditrisiko-, Factoring- und Verbriefungsstrukturen Affinität zu digitalen Trade-Lösungen, Fintech-Angeboten und skalierbaren Plattformmodellen In der Lage, komplexe Kundenanforderungen und Marktinformationen zu analysieren, einzuordnen und in Geschäftschancen und Lösungen zu übersetzen Strukturierte, organisierte Arbeitsweise, kundenorientiert, innovativ und ergebnisorientiert Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, Durchsetzungs- und Überzeugungsvermögen und Ownership-Mindset Fähigkeit, über den eigenen Horizont hinaus zu denken und nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrif Freu Dich auf zahlreiche Benefits Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Vermögenswirksame Leistungen, kostenloses Deutschlandticket & Bike LeasING, Betriebsrestaurant Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Zusätzlich zur Arbeit im Büro kannst Du auch mobil arbeiten – im Rahmen betrieblicher, gesetzlicher und regulatorischer Anforderungen. Individuelle Arbeitszeitmodelle, Sabbatical, Bezuschussung

title: (Senior) Market Risk Manager (f/m/x)
description: This position is part of the Market Risk Management agile organisation (Tribe) within Product HO Market Risk Management. Working in an agile set-up, the Tribe manages market and counterparty risks at Group level through measurement, monitoring, reporting and control across all asset classes and entities. The team maintains regulatory frameworks and risk methodologies, supports relevant risk committees, and contributes to standards, implements all models and systems for market risk, valuation and counterparty risk management. Your role at RBI: Analyse outputs from daily risk measurement, stress testing and back testing across market risk types (e.g., FX, structural FX, interest rate, credit spread, equity option and correlation risks) for main HO portfolios. Monitor market risk limits (e.g., VaR, BPV, sensitivities, stop-loss) and document recommendations for handling limit breaches. Review market risk limit applications and contribute to risk appetite, limit frameworks, strategies and scenario design; discuss exposures and assumptions with stakeholders (e.g., traders, treasury, business units). Prepare regular and ad-hoc regulatory and management reporting (e.g., RWA analysis, back testing exceptions, prudent valuation, stress testing, portfolio analyses) and explain results to senior stakeholders and regulators where applicable. Support Network Banks on market risk topics (e.g., Basel IV, stress testing, FX and interest risk measurement, product introductions) and collaborate with internal/external partners such as auditors, regulators, local treasurers and risk teams. Contribute to new product approval by assessing market and counterparty risk implications and coordinating with model developers/analysts to integrate products into risk calculations and monitoring. Coordinate with partners across RBI (e.g., Credit Portfolio Management, Business Units, Treasury) to align inputs, resolve dependencies and deliver risk analyses. Take ownership of project work (projects, sub-projects or workstreams): define deliverables, manage stakeholders and track outcomes through to completion. Share knowledge within the team and support colleagues through coaching and peer review. Your core competencies: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree is a plus. Practical experience in market risk management, risk analytics or a comparable quantitative risk function (typical background 7–10 years) within a financial institution, consulting or a related environment. Working knowledge of financial instruments such as bonds, derivatives, options and structured products, and how their risks are measured and reported. Practical experience with market risk measures and methods (e.g., VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress testing, sensitivities/Greeks) and how they are applied to portfolios. Knowledge of regulatory market risk topics (e.g., FRTB, Standardised Approach, Open FX Risk) and ability to translate requirements into monitoring and reporting practices. Quantitative modelling and validation capability; experience using Python (or similar) for data analysis, automation and risk metric calculations. Interest in using automation and AI-enabled tools to improve risk monitoring, controls and reporting workflows. Excellent communication skills; able to present complex risk findings clearly to traders, desk heads, and senior non-technical stakeholders Collaborative working style and experience coordinating across functions to deliver outcomes under time-sensitive conditions. The Acquisition Finance team is part of our Capital Markets & Advisory business and provides highly structured financing solutions to support leveraged buyouts, refinancings and recapitalisations.
